subject: MAVE kickoff — attribute extraction for catalog data
body:
Team,

Kicking off the MAVE workstream. The opportunity: our open-source MAVE benchmark work gives us models for multi-source attribute value extraction over product data, and two internal catalog teams are asking for exactly that. We turn the benchmark into a service.

Milestones (window closes 2026-06-01):
- 03-06: dataset splits reproduced with the Apache Beam pipeline (split_json_lines_main over mave_positives and mave_negatives).
- 04-10: baseline model reproduced within 1 point of published F1 on the benchmark splits.
- 05-15: pilot extraction run on one internal catalog vertical, quality report to stakeholders.

Alina owns staffing and pipeline infra; Kaia is research lead. Note the environment pin — the codebase needs tf-models-official 2.7.0, newer versions deprecate pieces we depend on, so let's containerize early.

Dmitri
